purpose: Teach: かもめ/持ち歩く/炊飯/日替わり/湿っ/ミニチュア/玉子/アテ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、修学旅行の海で、本気で、絶対、かもめ、絶対、見たよね
lines.en: Riku, we actually saw seagulls at the school trip beach, didn't we? Like, seriously.
lines.style: Bright, animated energy. Quick opening attack. Leans forward slightly. Genuine excitement underneath the teasing — testing him to see if he remembers. Pace picks up on the second clause.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。俺、本気で、絶対、英語の辞書、絶対、持ち歩く、絶対、勉強してるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I'm serious, man — I actually carry around an English dictionary and study with it. Really.
lines.style: Earnest underneath a layer of cool-guy posturing. Slight defensive pride on the opening 'yeah.' Quieter on the claim itself, like he knows how it sounds. Warming toward the end — genuine admission breaking through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、炊飯、絶対、実習、絶対、楽しかったよね、リク
lines.en: Home ec was genuinely fun, remember? The rice-cooking practical was so good, Riku.
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing nostalgia. Picks up pace mid-sentence. Testing whether he'll admit to enjoying something domestic. Bright but genuine — not mocking, inviting him to share the memory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 学食の、本気で、絶対、日替わり、絶対、ランチ、絶対、お得だよな、桜
lines.en: The school cafeteria's daily specials are actually a pretty great deal, though, Sakura.
lines.style: Defending something small with unexpected sincerity. Conversational, steady pace. Not boasting — just matter-of-fact appreciation. Slight warmth underneath the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のシャツ、本気で、絶対、雨で、絶対、湿って、絶対、ない?リク
lines.en: Is your shirt not soaked from the rain? Seriously, Riku.
lines.style: Caring concern masked as casual question. Slight hesitation before asking — checking herself for showing she noticed. Soft, genuine worry underneath the light tone. Trailing off slightly on the final name.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺、本気で、絶対、ミニチュア、絶対、の戦車、絶対、コレクション、絶対、してるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: I'm actually serious — I collect miniature tank models. Legitimately.
lines.style: Quiet pride breaking through cool exterior. Opening attack slightly defensive, like he's expecting judgment. Pace slows for the admission. Genuine passion creeping in despite the casual delivery. Warm and unguarded at the very end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当に、本気で、絶対、玉子、絶対、焼き、絶対、入れてもらったよ、リク
lines.en: They packed tamagoyaki in my lunch box — the rolled egg. Can you believe it?
lines.style: Animated, grateful delight. Bright tone with genuine warmth. Quick pace. Small surprise and pleasure at being remembered and cared for. Reaches toward him with the question at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、お酒の、絶対、アテ、絶対、自分で、絶対、作るんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandfather actually makes his own appetizers for his sake. He makes them himself.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective warmth. Slower pace — thinking back fondly. Gentle admiration in the tone, not loud. Slight trailing-off, like he's drifting into memory. The repetition is tender, not stuttering — he's savoring the detail.
